credits.intro: LibreCorsa is an open-source racing sim that runs in the browser. Drive open-wheelers, GT3 cars, LMDh and other prototypes, road cars, and classics like the Chaparral 2D, Porsche 934 and BMW M1 Procar, on circuits and hill climbs.
credits.supportModdersBody: The circuits and cars are their work, used with their permission. If you enjoy one, you can thank its maker directly.
credits.physicsBody: 500 Hz 6-DOF rigid-body solver, Pacejka Magic Formula & normalized-slip tyre models with 9-node thermal dynamics, active aerodynamics, and hybrid ERS.
credits.graphicsBody: WebGL2 PBR rendering with GPU tyre deformation, times of day from dawn to night, rain with wet and drying tracks, headlights and circuit lamps for night races, and multi-layer Web Audio synthesis.
credits.hudBody: The third-party HUD layouts are recreated from other open-source HUD projects, with LibreCorsa's own telemetry:
credits.pfalzdriverTitle: BMW M1 Procar, VW Scirocco and Porsche 934
credits.circuitsConverted: Converted for the simulator (rescaled, recentred, textures re-encoded, physics colliders added).
credits.sceneryNote: Simplified, textures re-encoded, placed at the circuit's tree, bush and helicopter spots. The stands and other props are the project's own.
credits.rightsBody: If you made a model, texture, sound or other asset used here and it is uncredited, credited wrongly, under the wrong license, or not meant to be in LibreCorsa, tell me: I will fix it or take it down, usually within 7 days.
credits.builtWith: Built with Next.js, React, Three.js and Tailwind CSS. Source code licensed under the GNU AGPL v3.0; 3D and audio assets are for non-commercial educational use only.

feedback.heading: Feedback
feedback.introBug: Report a bug: describe what went wrong and how to reproduce it. Session info below is optional.
feedback.introWheel: Report how your wheel behaves: steering, pedals, buttons and force feedback.
feedback.introIdea: Suggest a feature or an improvement.
feedback.introCar: Request a car: name it and link an eligible 3D model.
feedback.introTrack: Request a track: name the circuit and link an eligible 3D model or scan.
feedback.alwaysSentTitle: Always sent: GitHub's form needs it
feedback.pictureCopied: Copied. Paste it into the report on GitHub with Ctrl+V (Cmd+V on a Mac).
feedback.pictureSaved: Saved. Drag the file into the report on GitHub.
feedback.pictureFailed: This browser won't copy pictures. Save it instead and drag the file in.
feedback.lockedRipped: Models ripped from other games can't be added.
feedback.lockedLicense: It needs an open license or the creator's written permission first.
feedback.lockedModder: Ask the modder for permission first.
feedback.lockedSketchfab: Sketchfab is the last resort. Ask the sim modders first.
feedback.contentRules: LibreCorsa can only ship models it is allowed to share: ones under an open or non-commercial license (CC BY, CC BY-SA, CC0, CC BY-NC, CC BY-NC-SA) or with written permission from the creator. Mods taken from other games can only be used if their original creator agrees.
feedback.includedHint: Posted to a public GitHub issue. Click a line to omit it. Lines with a lock are always sent.
feedback.gameLogValue: {count, plural, one {# line, latest: {latest}} other {# lines, latest: {latest}}}
feedback.opensIssue: Opens a pre-filled GitHub issue (free account required).
feedback.sentNote: Check the new tab and press Create there to send it. Thanks.
feedback.sentNoteShot: Check the new tab and press Create there to send it. Add the screenshot there: copy it below, then paste it into the report. Thanks.
feedback.trimmedDetails: {count, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}} of game details didn't fit in GitHub's link and were left out.
feedback.trimmedLog: the older errors didn't fit in GitHub's link and were left out.
feedback.trimmedBoth: {count, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}} of game details and the older errors didn't fit in GitHub's link and were left out.
feedback.bugWhatPlaceholder: The car's wheels sink into the road in the last corner…
feedback.bugWhatError: Say what happened, in a few words at least.
feedback.bugStepsHint: The steps, even rough ones, e.g. “Load the circuit in the GT3, drive out of the pits”.
feedback.bugStepsError: Add the steps, even rough ones.
feedback.bugDeviceHint: The make and model, as written on the box.
feedback.wheelModelHint: The make and model of the base and of the rim.
feedback.wheelModelError: Name the wheel base and rim.
feedback.wheelFirmwareHint: Optional. The wheel maker's own app shows it.
feedback.wheelNotesHint: GitHub then asks which force-feedback path you used, with one click.
feedback.ideaPlaceholder: A replay camera that follows the leader…
feedback.ideaError: Describe the idea, in a few words at least.
feedback.ideaWhyHint: What it would fix or make more fun. Games that do it well help too.
feedback.ideaAreaHint: Menus, HUD, physics, AI, multiplayer, wheel, sound, graphics…
feedback.whichTrackHint: The name, and the layout or year.
feedback.modelLinkHint: The page of the 3D model: Sketchfab, a mod site or a scan. Requests without a model can't be built.
feedback.modelLinkCaution: A mod made for a racing sim is far better than Sketchfab: ask its modders first.
feedback.modelLinkError: Add a link to the 3D model, starting with https://
feedback.modelLinkShort: Paste the model's full page link (sketchfab.com/3d-models/…), not a short link, so its tags can be checked.
feedback.rippedTags: This model is tagged {tags} on Sketchfab: it was ripped from another game, so it can't be added. Find the mod's author and ask them for permission instead.
feedback.checkingTags: Checking the model's tags on Sketchfab…
feedback.tagsUnknown: Sketchfab didn't answer, so the model's tags will be checked by hand.
feedback.modderSaidYesTrack: I asked the modder who made this track for permission to use it in LibreCorsa, and they said yes. *
feedback.modderSaidYesCar: I asked the modder who made this car for permission to use it in LibreCorsa, and they said yes. *
feedback.modderSaidYesHint: Mods can only be added with their author's permission. Link their answer under Anything else.
feedback.askedModdersTrack: I asked the modders who made this track for other sim racing games for permission, and they said no. *
feedback.askedModdersCar: I asked the modders who made this car for other sim racing games for permission, and they said no. *
feedback.askedModdersTrackHint: Sketchfab tracks are made to look at, not to race on: no grip for the tarmac, no real kerbs, no racing line. A sim mod is far better, so ask its modders first.
feedback.askedModdersCarHint: Sketchfab cars are made to look at, not to drive: no physics comes with them. A sim mod is far better, so ask its modders first.
feedback.creator: Creator / modder
feedback.rippedUnknownLicense: Find out the model's license, or ask the creator for written permission: without either it can't be added.
feedback.rippedAskCreator: Ask the creator first, and link their answer under Anything else. Without an open license or their permission it can't be added.
feedback.notesPlaceholder: Why it would be fun, a link to the creator's permission, reference photos…
feedback.problemLink: Add a link to the 3D model (starting with https://).
feedback.problemShortLink: Paste the model's full Sketchfab page link.
feedback.problemChecking: Still checking the model's tags on Sketchfab.

modCatalogue.title: Packages to download
modCatalogue.intro: Offered for this copy of the game. Each download is checked against this list before it goes in.
modCatalogue.unreachable: The list of packages to download can't be reached. Check your connection, then try again.
modCatalogue.errorOffline: This device is offline. Connect to the internet, then try again.
modCatalogue.errorNetwork: The connection broke off. Try again.
modCatalogue.errorHttp: The server answered with error {status}: the package may have moved since the list was made.
modCatalogue.errorSize: The download isn't the size the list states: the package may have changed since the list was made. Nothing was installed.
modCatalogue.errorChecksum: The download doesn't match the list (its SHA-256 differs), so nothing was installed.
modCatalogue.errorInsecure: The download was sent on to an address that isn't secure (not https), so it wasn't read.

mods.intro: Mod packages add circuits, cars and liveries to the game. A package holds data only, never code, and stays in this browser until you remove it. Laps on a mod circuit or in a mod car are yours alone: they stay off the online boards and the weekly challenge.
mods.empty: No mods yet. Import a package's .zip or folder to add its circuits, cars and liveries.
mods.removeBody: Its circuits, cars and liveries leave the game when it restarts. Best laps you set on its circuits stay saved.
mods.broken: Problems (what they touch stays out of the game):
mods.moreProblems: {count, plural, one {and # more problem} other {and # more problems}}
mods.restartNeeded: Changes take effect when the game restarts.
mods.switchedOff: Mods are off for this visit (?mods=off in the address). Switch off or remove a broken package, then restart with them on.
mods.storageUnavailable: This browser can't keep mods here: a private window, or a page not served over https. The offline launcher's mods folder works instead.
mods.folderNote: Packages in the mods folder beside the game are listed here too. To remove one, delete its folder.
mods.launcherFolderNote: Packages in your mods folder are listed here too. Put a package's folder there to add it, and delete it to remove the package.

modConvert.title: Convert from another game
modConvert.intro: Copy a circuit's or a car's folder from Assetto Corsa or Speed Dreams into the launcher's import folder, then convert it here into a mod package. A circuit you modelled in Blender works too: its .glb export beside its settings .json.
modConvert.empty: Nothing in the import folder yet. Copy a circuit's or a car's folder there, then refresh.
modConvert.hintArchive: Unzip it into a folder here first.
modConvert.hintFile: A file: the converter takes a circuit's or a car's whole folder.
modConvert.hintLink: A link: copy the folder itself here.
modConvert.hintUnknown: Not a circuit or a car the converter recognises.
modConvert.hintNoImporter: This launcher's converter can't convert these yet.
modConvert.noConverter: This launcher came without its converter (the converter folder beside it), so it can't convert anything.
modConvert.toolsUnsupported: The converter's tools aren't available for this computer's system.
modConvert.toolsBody: Converting needs Python and Node.js. The launcher downloads them once, about {size} in all, and checks each download against a fingerprint built into it before anything runs. Nothing is downloaded until you press the button.
modConvert.toolsPython: Python {version} and the converters' packages, fetched by uv
modConvert.fetchingHint: This takes a few minutes the first time.
modConvert.convertingHint: A circuit takes a few minutes: its racing lines are worked out lap by lap.
modConvert.toolsFailed: The converter's tools couldn't be downloaded:
modConvert.convertedHint: It is in the mods folder, and joins the game when it restarts.
modConvert.licenceHint: A converted package keeps its source's licence. Most content from other games is for your own use only: don't share the package unless its licence allows it.
modConvert.logEarlier: {count, plural, one {(# earlier line not shown)} other {(# earlier lines not shown)}}
modConvert.errorBusy: Something is already converting or downloading: wait for it, or stop it.
modConvert.errorNotReady: The converter's tools aren't downloaded yet.
modConvert.errorLink: The folder holds a link to somewhere else: copy the files themselves into it.
modConvert.errorGone: That folder isn't in the import folder any more.
modConvert.noSession: Converting works only in the game window the launcher opened. Open the game from the launcher: start it again, or use the address it printed when it started.
